text: Red Bull GmbH is privately held: Mark Mateschitz holds a 49% stake in Red Bull inherited from his father, co-founder Dietrich Mateschitz, with the remaining stake held by the Thai Yoovidhya family (co-founded by Chaleo Yoovidhya). Neither owner is a state or state fund.

source.name: Reuters, Red Bull leadership after co-founder's death
source.quote: he had stepped down from his job at the company to focus on managing the 49% stake in Red Bull he inherited from his father
